name: proofpath-lab
description: BalanX ProofPath Lab: explore fictional workflow decisions, cite versioned evidence, and check predictions with an offline deterministic reference.

interface.longDescription: BalanX ProofPath Lab helps you practice evidence-aware workflow decisions using 16 fictional cases. Inspect versioned policy, consent, evidence, checkpoints and receipts; explain when to hold, refresh, reuse a confirmed receipt or propose a submission. A bundled offline checker scores explicitly supplied decisions against the public deterministic reference. The package uses synthetic fixtures only and has no MCP server, account, network calls or live submissions. The reference rules and deliberately brittle baseline are scripts, not measured language-model performance. If the host cannot execute the checker, the skill can explain the bundled cases and must label analysis as unexecuted. Intended for developers, educators and evaluators.
defaultPrompt: Walk me through a stale-evidence case in ProofPath.
Check my decision for a fictional ProofPath case.

prompts: Walk me through PP02 without revealing its expected answer until I choose a decision.
Explain why an accepted receipt with an unverified postcondition does not prove completion in PP05.
Score my PP01 decision: action submit, reason ready, evidence PP01-policy-v1, PP01-consent-v1 and PP01-evidence-v1, claims_success false, disclosed_fields service_zone and request_type.

publication.release_notes: BalanX branding and descriptive-copy revision. Runtime behavior and the bundled synthetic fixtures are unchanged.
